name: amverge

motion.feel: Tools in a cutting room: quick and mechanical. Metal and glass stop dead with no bounce; anything hinged or moved by a hand settles once and stops. Nothing floats, nothing drifts.

brief: The icon set of AMVerge, a desktop app that cuts an episode into clips and exports them. Dark window, green accent, icons drawn small - 12 to 35 px - in dense side panels, on clip tiles and in the player bar. The shapes are the Font Awesome solid glyphs the app already draws, kept exactly as they are; only the movement is new.
